## ICVO Pre-Merge Compliance Checklist

- [ ] **Infrastructure:** All local unit and integration tests passing (`flutter test`).
- [ ] **Compliance:** Gitleaks secret scan passed cleanly with zero exposed keys.
- [ ] **Validation:** Smoke test script verified against local/staging environment.
- [ ] **Observability:** Telemetry and exception logging confirmed intact.
- [ ] **Governance:** Does not breach Red Zone approval gates (Monetization, Budget > $100, Legal Scope).
